Maria S: Quick follow-up on the client-side credit adapter RFC — want to check tradeoffs for pushing more policy to the edge (SDK) vs keeping admission centralized.
Alex W: TL;DR: edge probes reduce tail latency but complicate fairness metrics.
Kevin L: Agree. Also abuse surface increases if we trust client-reported tokens.
Maria S: Right — proposal: signed lease tokens issued by central broker, client caches and reuses, adapter only does local batching and expiry.
Sam R: How do we handle partial revocation? i.e., revoke a lease mid-flight.
Alex W: We can include a short-lived revocation vector in the control plane; clients poll every N seconds. But that's extra chatter.
Joan P: Maybe use ephemeral revocation via push channel (ws) for long-running clients, poll fallback for intermittent.
Maria S: We discussed counters: keep central counters authoritative; client maintains local decrement-only cache to avoid double spend.
Kevin L: Metrics: we need to emit client-level deltas to central for auditing, but sampled to avoid cost.
Sam R: What about latency SLOs — can central check add too much headroom? We should allow local "fast-path" for low-risk tenants.
Maria S: Yeah, risk-scored tenants. High risk = central admission only; low risk = pre-warmed leases.
Alex W: Implementation note: adapter interface `AcquireLease(client_id, amount, trace_id)` return {lease_id, expiry, signature}
Alex W: snippet:
```:
resp = broker.AcquireLease(c, client, 100)
if resp.signature.verify(pub) and now < resp.expiry: use
else: fallback to remote admission
```
Joan P: Ops concern — tracing and attribution must survive client-side batching. Add `lease_id` to spans.
Maria S: Testing plan: synthetic churn with partial connectivity + abuse injection. Metrics: double-spend rate, false revoke latency, tail qps.
Kevin L: One more: enforce per-tenant daily cap centrally to avoid slow drain by many clients.
Sam R: sounds good. I'll prototype token revocation push using pubsub this week.
Maria S: Thanks — reassigning action items in the RFC doc. @alex @kevin pls add interface compat notes.
ops-bot: Note: created GH issue #4567 for client-lease revocation prototype
Maria S: cool :thumbsup:
